mappingSpace: samples destination is in the current legacy birth cell coordinate system, not world coordinates. Preserve current clip pivot, scene, clock, referenceLength and sourceFacing. Each samples index corresponds to one current playback sample; frame is native source cell index.
schemaNotes: nativeBodyFrames.image names are proposed deployment paths only. Copy localSourcePath bytes before registering.
nativeBodyFrames.frameCount counts source cells, while samples.length equals existing playback frameCount.
Do not draw old packed source plus new native source together. All four pebble forms have a separate packed-body runtime path that must also switch.
Seven mappings restore detail lost during prior whole-cell downsampling. They do not invent detail beyond original source artwork.
Spring composite forms have no higher-resolution original equivalent. Record their native limit rather than applying an upscale.

visualEvidence.finding: Directly inspected both contacts. Preserved sources retain surface, edge and facial detail; they are the same whole-body poses. Review contact enlarges small source for visibility, not for deployment.
